book.name: Makna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Makna Yesusmoa. Yesusva Nengthal Lohv, Sesoana Moalamangva Kuvuwulluhv.

content: Yesusm Duangindam Ningulangana.

Wo lingil lihavnamba, no Yutanindna kuwul indkumbiva moapetava henga ishuvna, ata es hevpa vinivav Yesusmba? Wo moamba ishopieinamba, ata os vinivav, wo polisi Yesusmba saongna ningina, wo ningulanga Pailat duangindam.
Doa di henga Pailat sah ovre, es hevpa yimba kuwul mendekli wulluhunvma Yutanindna? Doa Yesus ona, ten ye oimta.
Wo no kuwul, ten doara hev kevrinam, noi osva moangakala ovrivna, Yesusva os vevnata, osm Pailatm dasalm ovrivna. Os ningvna, Pailatva ata Yesusmba helvakomandhavav kana moara.
Wo Pailatva henga Yesusm omnana, yemba ambo mindnam indkokla ovriv, es yimba ata sesva ishunvav?
Wo Yesusva moamba hengava ishonamoa. Doa noinda Pailatva os nengaloh vevnamba, pai, hona indhanariniva es hevpa?
Pailatva Wohtna, Yesusmba Lepethalm.
Wo Pailat duangna wevsa os lohmanavna, Yutanindva no innemba mendekliva hlawuvnamba no tahonnam no tahonnam os hlawuvna, wo mongasal buinindrinim wolapho vawovna Yutanindna moara.
Wo nonamba mongova indhanariniva buimera livna, nihilva Barapas, wo himba daosnindm engalpethanamba, duangna valgonindm engvapingilm vevna, wo indhanamba helvakomo vivnamba, noinda bui vina.
Doa Yutanind mindnam prapianamba, Pailatm sah ovri, kam os vinu, mepev doara velohvm, mongongalm buimerinim wolaihapho.
Wo Pailat nengna, honi indhanamba Yesusmba musk vinivmoa, kuwulangas hev Yesusmba muembnavho vriv, wo noinda Pailat unna, es yimba ningv, Yesusm kava wolaihaphovavma, men yena kuwul wulluhunvm?
Doa sembayang andranindna kuwulva di mura lovahvna, no moamba hillinvnamba, wo ombandhanam otuhtina, osm mindnam Pailatm umnira, os Barapasmoa wolaihapho, Yesusva owai.
Wo henga Pailat osah owol ve, es ata kava eva venavav Yesusmba, memba osva yimba ningthivpa, Yutanindna kuwul?
Doa he di mindnam umnina, pakona hemoa tira krusera lepetheiu.
Doa Pailat henga unna, owai, heva os mana vemakoklava venamoa. Wo henga he di mindnam umnina, pakona lepetheiu krusera.

Wo Pailatva hena moamba hillinnamba, wo Barapasm wolaihinginna, doa Yesusm hevna valgonindindam wolaihangavna, wo valgonindva ambo esvema di Yesusmba hilvi wepondanasna. Doa Pailat hevna valgonindm unna, pakonaoa daha os lepetheiu.
Valgonindva Yesusm Dasalm Moari Ovruwuvna.
Doa valgonindva Yesusmba waianganamba Pailatduangna pueilmera, wo indkumbim valgonindm nembapho vi, nonglalm.
Wo Yesusmba kayen aembul vithimninamba, wo topilm wesel nasna weilvrimnina, wo kura weilholothumnie Yesusm, dasalm ambo osm ora memba kuwul.
Doa Yesusm dasalm ambo moari ovruwuvna, yimba Yutanindna kuwul a?
Wo tengana kuval hevri, wo muembksvna wehla, wo dasalm mulumbdandna ambo lovahthamnavna, os kuwulm ten vewol vinivm.
Wo osva moari vepiemninamba, wo kayen aembulva henga selvoreimnivna, hevna henga vithimnivna, wo Yesusmba waianga, kruseram lepethalm.
Valgonindva Yesusm Krusera Pakona Lepetheina.

Wo Yesusmba monara waiangavna, mongo indhanariniva provna monam, nihilva Simon, oklamini himba provna, wo Yerusalemram pholm vevna, no Simonmba Aleksandaina Rupusina aral, wo Sairini kotanindrini. Doa valgonind umnina, Yesusna kruseoa pungao.
Wo Yesusmba dem waipulvo, nomba os ningthiv Golkota nomba olomba, osm ovna, oi indhanana kukel.
Wo Yesusm wainmba daholm vivna, no wainmba obatnahonam moakot vinamba, osm daholm vivna, ata humeis nihsesoa venavm, heva os owai, Yesusva nenamoa.
Doa pakona kruserava hevpa lepetheinamba. Wo Yesusna malova dumbnamba, doa pilai win vivna, osm hevm moang viwul vina mongom mongom.
Wo Yesusmba nonamba krusera simolnam lepetheivnamba, dihi os yamba 9pelara vevna.
Wo valgonindva nomba hevna volm vina, wo krusesra sena os moapeta tombaira kleihina, osm hona moara lepetheie, wo os moapetava kleihina, Memba Yesus, Yutanindna Kuwul.

Doa indhanarini samblava di Yesusinda murapeta krusera lepethiwulna, nomba indhanarini samblava helvakomonindrini sambla, lepethiwulna noinda. Mongova sihanasis eva mongova nihanasis, os lepethiwulna.

Doa indhanamba di monarava kohawovnamba, wo Yesusm nonglavol ovovna, loskas ovrakov ovrivna, ye honi kana tempelduvpa Yerusalemrinimba taka velva olohvnama, wo ovna, kava henga si samblamongo okombanam ambo dembravav?
Pev doara ten indhanam wolapho vevnam, eva os pevmoa wuleihota, kruserinioa holopeo.
Doa no Yutanindna kuwul indkumbi os hevm moarialm ishune, pim wolapho velm prona hona pethara, heva os hevpa owai, kruserinimba holopevmoa.

Ai Sesoava yemba tanamba doarava pusvundthoatava, wo tanam yimba kana kuwul wulluhunvtava, wo daipotaoa kruserinioa os eva holopeota, wo yemba kava undnahonam lovahthamnavav, tanam lehra lohv. Wo no daosnindrini samblava hevna kruse pethalliniva eva ohokosv venata Yesusmba.
Yesusmba Os Wohvitivhoana.
Wo okombava hovrava lohvnamba, doa heva os simsna okilvra, venamba, okomba vohanam yam 3pelara vena.
Doa nonamba Yesus hevnamona kinge o, os eloi eloi lama sapaktani, osm ovna, kana Sesoa, kana Sesoa, manara yimba kamba nunglulihai?
Doa mura mongova di hillilvahvna no moamba, wo os una, pai, hillu, Yesusva Elaitam wunuhomnav, ten doara heva amana venam.

Doa mongo indhanarini lelnam ganamba, lembatamsna vranamba, wainpolla velthanamba, wo tenglara lothonamba, wo Yesusm mengval nethavongovna mengutilm. Wo ona, piv dawonam nunglul lovahv, ata Elaita provmi, wolaihapihavmi owaimi?
Doa Yesusva eunillam kinge onamba mindnam, wo wohdaha.

Doa wohdahanamba, wo mana vema os phona tempelmera di Yerusalemra, wo kayenmba mendekliva merava tempelduvra kleihalohvnamba, mongo tuvra diva kleihalohvnamba, wo heva hev ambo hovrahovra powalwolna. Os powalwolna dipeh, venamba dingoho.
Doa Yesusva nonamba dahavnamba, wo mongo valgonindna kuwul nunglul lohvna, Yesusva hena novra wohdahana, wo hev ona, tanamolnam hona indhanariniva Sesoana ombolta.
Wo eva mongova ungevliva okla lovahvna, nonglanga velvohvna. Honi lovahvna, Salome, Maria Maktalarini, Maria Yemsina Yosepina aval, no Yemsva boasalal lohvna.

No ungevliva doarava engpethalvohmana vevna, Yesusva diva Galili provinsrava andra vevnamba, wo hetindim innemba dahwol velvohvna. Wo mongla ungevli mindnam di eva Yesusm nunglul lovahvna, ten Yesusm Galilirini Yerusalemram doara engambnam.
Yesusmindmba Honmera Singvina.

Okombava pelangalla avnamba, wo mongova Yutanindna kuwul provna, nihilva Yosep. Himba besal lohvna, Arimatia kembellini. Wo himba indva wulluhunvna, Sesoava si hevna nemeltindimba beswonam wonavav, wo himba nom nengaomana vevna. Wo himba doara nengna, simba ata kilvravav, simerava temba vah iaevulvav. Wo es hevpa Yesusva mindilva vindkleihalohvav kruserava. Ambo os nengvna, ambo ka gavai, Pailat duangm osahmana, es hevpa Yesusmindmba kava ata detiva singvivavma? Wo pepehtovpa piengana, ambo nis ganamba, Pailatm osahmanana.
Wo himba hellenamba, ona pai, es hevpa Yesusmba lelnamba dahai? Wo wunuhomna valgonindna kuwul, noi wulluhunvnam, wo sah ovre, es hevpa Yesusva doa dahaimi, owaimi?
Wo no valgonindna kuwul omnana, doa dahaita, wo noinda Pailat Yosepm omnana, wouta gao, vindpipahota, wo singviu pokamara.

Wo Yoseppa ganamba, kayen dombal nemel sovakanamba, wulpro, Yesusm kruserini vindpipaha, no kayenna ningenamba, honmera yitha, no melva doara hina indhana hev. Doa hon mendekli vaval umharavho vrunganamba, no melva ehlatha.
Wo Maria Maktalarinii, Maria Yosepna avali, himba nonamba di nunglul elohvna, Yoseppa Yesusmindmba honmerava vindithavnamba, ona nolhra ten.
